name: desk-repro-base-r2
cmd: set -e; mkdir -p {out}/desk/tmp; printf '%s' '{"desk": {"selection_metric": "val_kernel", "trend": {"seed": 0, "buffer_floor": 2, "direction_anchor_year": 1996, "direction_withheld_anchor_year": 1975, "holdout_years": [], "common_holdout_years": []}}, "paths": {"desk_output_dir": "{out}/desk"}}' > {out}/overlay.json; export ESK_DESK_CONFIG={out}/overlay.json TMPDIR={out}/desk/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR={out}/desk/tmp/mpl WANDB_MODE=offline WANDB_DIR={out}/desk; {python} scripts/run_encoder.py desk
note: Phase 0.4: rerun of sweep_t0_f100_base with the code that trained it (bcba64c8; no training seed plumbed then, so r1/r2 also show local run-to-run spread). Gate: best val_kernel within the 6.6% seed floor of TACC's 0.006956.
